name: Dombay
description: Star of 5,185 K, 135 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

text.card: HAT-P-3 b crosses Dombay as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius and temperature follow Stassun et al. 2017.

quotes.title: HAT-P-3
quotes.card: HAT-P-3, is a metal-rich K5 dwarf star located about 441 light-years away in the constellation Ursa Major.
quotes.introduction: At a magnitude of about 11.5 it is not visible to the naked eye but is visible in a small to medium-sized amateur telescope.
